findings.title: A joined Book becomes guidance in motion
findings.claim: Across this pericope, the written Book can be read as a joined and firmly ordered whole whose signs guide conduct; the later path wording lets that guidance carry the image of a leading front.
findings.mechanism: The focus pairs the singular book with plural signs, bringing the book's joining facet into contact with its components. Its wise/corrective quality meets the guidance named in 31:3 and 31:5, and the explicit path in 31:6 supplies an independent route for the nominated leading-front image. The resulting relation turns textual coherence into direction a reader can follow.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive how the signs cohere as a dependable text and how that text's order moves outward as guidance rather than remaining information on a page.
findings.containment: The plain claim that these are verses of the wise Book remains intact. Joining, restraint, firmness, and leading are bounded contextual facets; they do not make the book a literal stitched object or establish a surah-wide channel.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel supports and exact supplied context text ground the relation, while the leading-front image is a nominated branch and its context word morphology is not supplied.

The focus's wise quality also meets the context's certainty as a knowledge-and-reason outcome.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see wisdom as a relation that changes orientation and conduct until understanding settles, rather than solely as restraint.
findings.containment: The HFT source itself marks the feedback loop as reader inference: these may be effects in the people who receive the Book rather than a mechanism belonging to the Book. The ordinary wise quality and the stated guidance, mercy, practices, and certainty remain intact.

epistemic.reason: The supplied Arabic verifies the exact anchor verses, while HFT segmentation, target morphology, and root-to-word mappings remain attributed; the source also marks the feedback loop as an inference.

findings.mechanism: The HFT trace links the focus text to the acquired diversion in 31:6, then to sequential recitation in 31:7. It traces the break from recited signs through deliberate turning, simulated non-hearing, and the image of weight in the ears, changing a static-store reading into a contested path from message to response.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the Book as a live transmission that enters time and can be met by rival attention or by refusal at the point where hearing could become response.
findings.containment: The focus still describes signs of a Book, and 31:7's repeated as-if wording keeps blocked reception as a represented stance rather than proof of absent sound. The HFT source allows the contrast to be ethical rather than a general model of attention, and its roles remain attributed.

epistemic.reason: The exact Arabic context anchors are supplied, but HFT segmentation, morphology, and branch mappings are attributed; the source preserves an alternative ethical reading.

findings.title: Textual coherence meets measured creation
findings.claim: The focus Book's joining and firmness can be read beside the measured creation described in 31:10: a world with supports, stabilizing anchors, distributed life, and growth gives the text's coherence a world-scale companion. The focus's signs can also be heard as pointing toward this visible order.

After context, its joining and settled firmness meet the 31:10 sequence of proportioned creation, support, fixing against sway, dispersion, and growth, becoming a qualified world-scale comparison. Independently, the focus word for signs meets this visible creation sequence, allowing the text's signs to point outward to an ordered world. The resulting comparison places creation beside the Book without identifying them.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the Book's coherence alongside a visible order in which distinct operations hold together and produce growth.
findings.containment: The relation is a qualified contextual comparison and an inference from supplied wording. It does not claim that creation literally is the Book, that 31:10 calls itself an ayah, or that the focus and creation share a mechanism beyond the stated pattern.

epistemic.reason: The exact 31:10 Arabic and HFT roles are supplied, but the trace is legacy_unbound and explicitly marks the control-diagram synthesis as reader inference; the additional sign-to-creation contact is a bounded inference from the focus sign word and visible context.
